mapper.sql: N.ID, N.CHILD_ID, N.AUTHOR, N.CONTENT, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(N.CREATED_AT) * 1000 CREATED_AT, (SELECT U.NAME FROM T_USER U WHERE U.ID = N.AUTHOR) AUTHOR_NAME
mapper.select: SELECT FROM T_PARENT_NOTE N WHERE N.CHILD_ID = #{childId} ORDER BY N.ID DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_PARENT_NOTE(CHILD_ID, AUTHOR, CONTENT) VALUES (#{childId}, #{author}, #{content})
mapper.sql: C.ID, C.NOTE_ID, C.AUTHOR, C.CONTENT, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(C.CREATED_AT) * 1000 CREATED_AT, (SELECT U.NAME FROM T_USER U WHERE U.ID = C.AUTHOR) AUTHOR_NAME
mapper.select: SELECT FROM T_PARENT_NOTE_COMMENT C WHERE C.NOTE_ID = #{noteId} ORDER BY C.ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_PARENT_NOTE_COMMENT(NOTE_ID, AUTHOR, CONTENT) VALUES (#{noteId}, #{author}, #{content})
